# `vox-similarity`

**Crate:** `vox-similarity` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

Pure simhash/minhash/LSH near-duplicate similarity core for Vox discovery and marketplace dedup.

## Crate Overview

Pure near-duplicate similarity core: simhash + minhash signatures, an LSH
band index, clustering, and one-vs-many overlap. No filesystem, DB, or network.
